title: Learning the guitar
instructions: Lara gitar öğrenmeyi anlatıyor. Ne zaman başladığına ve nasıl çalıştığına dikkat et.

script.speaker: lara
script.text: I started learning the guitar six months ago.

script.speaker: lara
script.text: I don't have a teacher. I learn from videos on the internet.

script.speaker: lara
script.text: I practise for half an hour every evening after dinner.

script.speaker: lara
script.text: At first, my fingers hurt a lot, but now it's easier.

script.speaker: lara
